CWE-112.name: Missing XML Validation
CWE-112.original_description: The product accepts XML from an untrusted source but does not validate the XML against the proper schema.
CWE-112.description: The product accepts XML from an untrusted source but does not validate the XML against the proper schema. Most successful attacks begin with a violation of the programmer's assumptions. By accepting an XML document without validating it against a DTD or XML schema, the programmer leaves a door open for attackers to provide unexpected, unreasonable, or malicious input. In Python codebases this weakness typically appears via high-level APIs (web frameworks, DB-API/ORM, subprocess, pathlib, serialization) rather than raw memory ops.
CWE-112.detection_notes: MITRE detection methods: Automated Static Analysis.
